claim: An S3 File Gateway supports up to 50 file shares per gateway. Each file share can connect to only one S3 bucket, and several file shares can connect to the same bucket if each uses a unique, non-overlapping prefix name.
question: How many file shares can one S3 File Gateway have, and how many S3 buckets can one file share connect to?

qualifiers.scope: file shares per S3 File Gateway
qualifiers.condition: file shares that use the same bucket need unique, non-overlapping prefix names

evidence.quote:
| Maximum number of file shares per gateway Each file share can only connect to one S3 bucket, but multiple file shares can connect to the same bucket. If you connect more than one file share to the same bucket, you must configure each file share to use a unique, non-overlapping prefix name to prevent read/write conflicts.
The number of file shares managed by a gateway can impact the gateway's performance. For more information, see [Performance guidance for gateways with multiple file shares](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/Performance.html#performance-multiple-file-shares). | 50 |

| [Increased maximum file shares per gateway](#DocumentHistory) | S3 File Gateway now supports up to 50 file shares per gateway, increased from the previous limit of 10. This allows you to create more file shares on a single gateway, reducing the number of gateways you need to manage. For more information, see [Quotas for file shares ](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/fgw-quotas.html). | January 18, 2023 |

note: d25-030, d25-041. Older material says 10 file shares per gateway. The General Reference quota table says 1 file share per S3 bucket, which differs from this page (see storage-gateway-quota-file-shares-per-bucket-gr).

claim: The maximum size of an individual file on an S3 File Gateway is 5 TiB. If you write a larger file piece by piece, only the first 5 TiB is uploaded; if you write it all at once, a Windows client creates no file and a Linux client creates a file of size zero.
question: What is the maximum size of an individual file on an S3 File Gateway, and what happens to a larger file?

qualifiers.scope: individual file on an S3 File Gateway
qualifiers.condition: a larger file is truncated at 5 TiB when written piece by piece

evidence.quote: | The maximum size of an individual file If you try to write files larger than the size limit piece by piece, only the first 5 TiB will be uploaded. If you try to write the files larger than the size limit all at once, on Windows clients no file is created and on Linux clients a file of size zero is created. | 5 TiB |

note: d25-030, d25-035. The Storage Gateway FAQ says 5 TB for the same limit (storage-gateway-faq-s3-file-max-file-size); this quota page says 5 TiB. Not the S3 object maximum: see s3-change-max-object-size-50-tb-2025-12.

claim: The GatewayCapacity setting of an S3 File Gateway sets how many files the gateway can cache metadata for at the same time: Small is 5M files, Medium is 10M files and Large is 20M files.
question: How many files can an S3 File Gateway cache metadata for at the same time at each GatewayCapacity setting?

qualifiers.scope: files with cached metadata per S3 File Gateway, set with GatewayCapacity
qualifiers.condition: the setting is configurable and impacts gateway performance and hardware recommendations

evidence.quote:
| The maximum number of files for which a gateway can simultaneously cache metadata Because S3 File Gateway is backed by Amazon S3, there is no maximum folder size or limit to the number of files that you can store or access using a gateway.
Each gateway has a configurable limit that determines the number of files for which it can simultaneously cache metadata. You can use the [UpdateGatewayInformation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/APIReference/API_UpdateGatewayInformation.html) API action to set [GatewayCapacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/APIReference/API_UpdateGatewayInformation.html#StorageGateway-UpdateGatewayInformation-request-GatewayCapacity) to `Small`, `Medium`, or `Large`. This setting impacts gateway performance and hardware recommendations. For more information, see [Performance guidance for gateways with multiple file shares](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/performance-multiple-file-shares.html). | **Gateway Capacity:**
Small — 5M files
Medium — 10M files
Large — 20M files |

note: d25-030. Same row: there is no maximum folder size or limit to the number of files stored in S3 through the gateway.

claim: The maximum path length on an S3 File Gateway is 1024 bytes, calculated from UTF-8 character bit values. Clients cannot create a longer path, and this limit applies to both NFS and SMB.
question: What is the maximum path length on an S3 File Gateway?

qualifiers.scope: path length on an S3 File Gateway, NFS and SMB
qualifiers.condition: path length in bytes uses UTF-8 encoding

evidence.quote:
| Maximum path length Clients are not allowed to create a path exceeding this length, and doing so results in an error. This limit applies to both protocols supported by File Gateways, NFS and SMB.
Path length in bytes is calculated from character bit values in UTF-8 encoding. | 1024 bytes |
